title: Replace high ESR input capacitor
problem_description: Pilot controller boards show higher than expected input ripple during temperature soak when the current capacitor lot is installed.
proposed_fix: Approve the lower ESR capacitor already validated on the sensor hub board and update inspection notes for derating verification.
analyst_remarks: Converted to an engineering order after electrical validation data was attached.

title: Revise screw kitting label for panel build
problem_description: Assembly operators are selecting mixed screw finishes because the workstation kitting label does not distinguish the approved stainless pan head screw.
proposed_fix: Update the kitting label and bin photo standard so only FAS-01323 stainless screws are issued for the panel station.
analyst_remarks: Manufacturing review accepted and requested line supervisor confirmation.

title: Approve low profile service connector
problem_description: The current right angle connector interferes with the compact enclosure wall during service cable insertion.
proposed_fix: Change the service connector callout to the approved low profile configuration and revise mating cable clearance notes.
analyst_remarks: Analyst assigned procurement and quality impact checks.

title: Add IMU module pull up option
problem_description: The optional motion sensor module has intermittent I2C startup failures on prototype boards with long harness runs.
proposed_fix: Add configurable pull up resistor placements and release a board note describing population options for the IMU interface.
analyst_remarks: Initial screening is pending affected item confirmation.

title: Release harness strain relief fixture
problem_description: Harness assemblies are being routed inconsistently and several pilot units show strain at the connector exit.
proposed_fix: Release a simple clamp fixture and update the operator instruction with continuity check and strain relief verification steps.
analyst_remarks: Manufacturing evidence package is being collected.

title: Retry firmware checksum release
problem_description: The firmware release package failed downstream checksum validation during the publication attempt.
proposed_fix: Regenerate the signed release archive, attach the SHA256 checksum, and repeat the repository validation before release.
analyst_remarks: Firmware analyst requested repository tag evidence.

title: Update bearing press verification
problem_description: Gearbox builds need a documented press depth check for the sealed bearing replacement operation.
proposed_fix: Add a go no go gauge step to the work instruction and require lot traceability entry at the workstation.
analyst_remarks: Converted after manufacturing lead accepted the fixture update.

title: Correct compliance certificate package link
problem_description: Released control panel documentation points to an older certificate package and may confuse field service teams.
proposed_fix: Update the linked CMP-0032 package and revise the release checklist so the current declaration is attached.
analyst_remarks: Low risk document linkage change converted to an order.

title: Improve regulator inductor noise margin
problem_description: Prototype power measurements show a marginal noise peak when the selected inductor is loaded near the upper current range.
proposed_fix: Evaluate the shielded 22 uH inductor option and bump the item revision if DCR and thermal tests pass.
analyst_remarks: Electrical test data is still pending.

title: Standardize enclosure gasket inspection
problem_description: Pilot enclosure builds use different gasket compression checks between shifts, causing inconsistent acceptance decisions.
proposed_fix: Add a single inspection gauge method and update the traveler for ENC-00212 assembly verification.
analyst_remarks: Quality review requested first article evidence.

title: Revise burn in test procedure
problem_description: The existing burn in procedure does not verify network communication recovery after a power cycle event.
proposed_fix: Update TPR-0117 to add a communication check after each power cycle and require captured logs in the validation folder.
analyst_remarks: Converted to a process related engineering order for document control release.

title: Reassess DIN rail power supply source
problem_description: The proposed DIN rail supply lacks complete regional safety evidence for the target pilot cabinet.
proposed_fix: Block release of PSA-000089 until the supplier provides UL and CE certificates or an approved alternate is selected.
analyst_remarks: Rejected due to missing compliance evidence and single source risk.

title: Revise motor encoder cable routing
problem_description: Actuator fixture builds show abrasion risk where the motor encoder cable crosses the gearbox bracket edge.
proposed_fix: Add an alternate routing path with a protective clip and update the fixture photo standard for MOT-00165 installations.
analyst_remarks: Temporary deviation option is being reviewed.

title: Update sensor module calibration note
problem_description: Sensor module assemblies are being released without a clear instruction for when the calibration table must be loaded.
proposed_fix: Add the calibration table instruction to SEN-000305 affected item release notes and verification checklist.
analyst_remarks: Awaiting firmware and quality routing decision.

title: Add gearbox work cell tooling
problem_description: The gearbox assembly cell needs a bearing press locator and revised torque sequence before production ramp.
proposed_fix: Release the tooling kit and update work instructions for GEA-00094 with operator training signoff.
analyst_remarks: Manufacturing and procurement impact review started.

title: Update carton and foam packaging
problem_description: Drop test preparation found that the carton insert stackup does not consistently retain the sensor hub accessory kit.
proposed_fix: Revise RCT-0153 carton artwork and PFI-0220 foam geometry before customer pilot shipment release.
analyst_remarks: Packaging engineering review is pending.

title: Block obsolete shipping label
problem_description: A lithium caution label request was raised against an inactive category and lacks approved artwork traceability.
proposed_fix: Reject use of SLB-0399 and require category reactivation plus controlled artwork approval before resubmission.
analyst_remarks: Rejected because the label category is inactive and artwork evidence is missing.

title: Update control panel connector layout build aid
problem_description: Panel assemblers need a clearer visual aid after the connector layout revision to avoid cross wiring at final test.
proposed_fix: Publish a revised build aid with connector reference designators and add a first shift verification checkpoint.
analyst_remarks: Manufacturing lead is gathering pilot defect examples.

title: Refresh installation guide template
problem_description: The installation guide uses an older safety notice format and omits the compact sensor hub mounting clearance note.
proposed_fix: Revise IGD-0043 using the current template and add the mounting clearance drawing before document release.
analyst_remarks: Document control accepted the scope as a minor revision.

title: Improve PCB rework tracking
problem_description: Pilot PCB rework records do not consistently identify which assemblies received the connector clearance change.
proposed_fix: Add a rework traveler field for PCB-000519 and require serial number capture before the unit returns to test.
analyst_remarks: Awaiting quality input on traveler retention.

title: Release configuration tool installer signature note
problem_description: Validation workstations need a consistent instruction to verify the configuration tool installer signature before use.
proposed_fix: Update CFG-00065 release notes and add the installer signature check to the provisioning procedure.
analyst_remarks: Converted after IT confirmed signature verification requirement.

title: Revise user manual diagnostic screens
problem_description: The user manual does not match the latest control panel diagnostic screen names used during pilot support.
proposed_fix: Update UMN-0077 screenshots and navigation steps to match the released panel configuration profile.
analyst_remarks: Customer support review will be required before approval.

title: Complete foam density trial release
problem_description: Packaging validation used an alternate foam density and the production traveler must document the approved use up rule.
proposed_fix: Update packaging work instructions to allow the validated foam density for the pilot lot and record lot consumption.
analyst_remarks: Converted to close the completed packaging deviation trail.

title: Strengthen secure bootloader preload controls
problem_description: Pilot units can be flashed manually but there is no checklist verifying boot key provisioning before application firmware load.
proposed_fix: Add a bootloader preload checklist for BLD-00035 and require key verification evidence before final firmware programming.
analyst_remarks: Firmware and quality reviewers have been added to routing.

title: Cancel duplicate tactile switch request
problem_description: The proposed tactile switch duplicates an existing released switch and does not provide lifecycle or force tolerance justification.
proposed_fix: Reject SWT-000290 release and direct the requester to use the existing approved switch unless an exception is documented.
analyst_remarks: Rejected as a duplicate component request with incomplete evidence.
